notes: ML_RULE_50094_1.sas is a SAS Fraud Decisioning rule-editor fragment (declare/try-catch/pmml.score()/detection.Alert()), not a standalone program in any SAS dialect -- it has no data/proc wrapper and references the rule engine's implicit message-schema variables. This bundle is a DATA-step caller that transcribes the rule's own documented FALLBACK scoring path verbatim: the same logistic-regression coefficients and the same 0.70/0.60/0.40 decision thresholds from the rule's catch branch, applied to 15 rows sampled directly from the repo's own fraud_training_data.csv (inlined via DATALINES since the runner sends only script text, not sibling data files).
